instagram.metaTitle: Instagram Reels Downloader — Save Reels & Videos Free
instagram.metaDescription: Free Instagram Reels downloader. Paste a Reel, video or post link and save it as an MP4 to your phone or computer. No login, no app, no signup.
instagram.lead: Paste the link of any public Instagram Reel, video post or IGTV video and save it as an MP4 in seconds. It works on iPhone, Android and desktop, with no login and nothing to install.
instagram.copyHint: In the Instagram app, open the Reel, tap Share, then Copy link.

faq.q: Can I download Instagram Reels from a private account?
faq.a: No. Only public posts can be downloaded. Private accounts restrict their content to approved followers, and this tool never asks for your Instagram login.

faq.q: Which Instagram links work?
faq.a: Reel links (instagram.com/reel/…), video posts (/p/…), IGTV (/tv/…) and Instagram share links. Posts that only contain photos have no video to save.

faq.q: Why is my downloaded Instagram video silent?
faq.a: Some clips are posted without sound, and Instagram sometimes delivers video and audio as separate files. When only a video-only file is available we tell you, and if a separate audio track is offered you can save it with the audio button.

youtube.metaTitle: YouTube Shorts & Video Downloader — Free MP4 Download
youtube.metaDescription: Download YouTube Shorts and videos as MP4 for free. Paste a youtube.com or youtu.be link and save it with sound. No login, no software.
youtube.lead: Paste a YouTube Shorts or video link (youtube.com or youtu.be) and save it as an MP4 with sound. It's free, needs no account and works in any browser.
youtube.copyHint: In the YouTube app, tap Share, then Copy link. On a computer, copy the address from your browser.

faq.q: What quality do I get when downloading from YouTube?
faq.a: You get a single MP4 file with sound. YouTube normally offers those ready-made files at up to 360p; higher resolutions are delivered as separate video and audio streams that can't be combined here, so 360p is the practical ceiling for now.

faq.q: Can I download YouTube Shorts?
faq.a: Yes. Paste the Shorts link (youtube.com/shorts/…) or the share link and it downloads like any other video.

faq.q: Can I download age-restricted or private YouTube videos?
faq.a: No. Those need a signed-in YouTube account, which this tool never uses. Public videos work; private, members-only and age-restricted ones don't.

facebook.metaTitle: Facebook Video Downloader — Save Videos & Reels Free
facebook.metaDescription: Free Facebook video downloader. Paste a Facebook video, Reel or fb.watch link and save it as an MP4. No login, no app to install.
facebook.lead: Paste a public Facebook video, Reel or fb.watch link and save it as an MP4. It works on phones and computers, and you don't need to sign in to anything.
facebook.copyHint: Tap Share under the video, then Copy link.

faq.q: Which Facebook links are supported?
faq.a: Video links (facebook.com/watch and /videos/), Reels (/reel/), Facebook share links and fb.watch short links. Photos and text posts have no video to download.

faq.q: Can I download videos from private groups or friends-only posts?
faq.a: No. Only public videos can be fetched. Content limited to friends or group members requires a Facebook login, which this tool doesn't use.

faq.q: Why did my Facebook link fail?
faq.a: The video is probably not public, has been deleted, or is restricted in some regions. Check that it opens in a private browser window without logging in; if it does, try again in a minute.

threads.metaTitle: Threads Video Downloader — Save Threads Videos (MP4)
threads.metaDescription: Download videos from Threads posts as MP4 for free. Paste a threads.net or threads.com link. No login, no app needed.
threads.lead: Paste the link of a public Threads post with a video and save it as an MP4. Both threads.net and threads.com links work, and there's nothing to install.
threads.copyHint: Tap the Share icon on the post, then Copy link.

faq.q: Do threads.com and threads.net links both work?
faq.a: Yes. Threads uses both domains, and links from either one are accepted, including the share links the app creates.

faq.q: Can I download photos from Threads?
faq.a: This tool saves videos. A post that only contains photos or text has no video, so there is nothing to download.

faq.q: Why doesn't my Threads link work?
faq.a: Threads support is newer and depends on what Threads publicly shows for a post. Posts from private profiles, or without a video, can't be downloaded; if a public video fails, try again later.

x.metaTitle: Twitter (X) Video Downloader — Save Tweet Videos as MP4
x.metaDescription: Download Twitter and X videos as MP4 for free. Paste a post link from x.com or twitter.com. No login, no app.
x.lead: Paste the link of a public post on X (formerly Twitter) and save its video as an MP4. Both x.com and twitter.com links work, and no login is needed.
x.copyHint: Tap the Share icon under the post, then Copy link.

faq.q: Do x.com and twitter.com links both work?
faq.a: Yes. Twitter is now X, and the old twitter.com links still point to the same posts, so both are accepted.

faq.q: Can I download GIFs from Twitter?
faq.a: Twitter stores GIFs as short MP4 videos, so GIF posts normally download as an MP4 file.

faq.q: What if a post has several videos?
faq.a: Each video is listed separately with its own Download button, and there's a Download all option.

pinterest.metaTitle: Pinterest Video Downloader — Save Pins as MP4 Free
pinterest.metaDescription: Free Pinterest video downloader. Paste a pin or pin.it link and save the video as an MP4. No login, no app.
pinterest.lead: Paste the link of a Pinterest video pin and save it as an MP4 in seconds. Short pin.it links work too, and you never need to sign in.
pinterest.copyHint: Open the pin, tap Share, then Copy link.

faq.q: Does it work with pin.it short links?
faq.a: Yes. We follow the short link to the real pin automatically, so you can paste whatever the app gives you.

faq.q: Can I download image pins?
faq.a: No. This tool is for video pins. Image pins contain no video.

faq.q: Do country versions of Pinterest work?
faq.a: Yes. Links from pinterest.com and regional sites such as pinterest.co.uk or pinterest.fr are accepted.

tiktok.metaTitle: TikTok Video Downloader — Save TikTok Videos as MP4
tiktok.metaDescription: Free TikTok video downloader. Paste a TikTok or vm.tiktok.com link and save the video as an MP4. No login, no app.
tiktok.lead: Paste a public TikTok link and save the video as an MP4 in seconds. Short links from the TikTok app work too, and you don't need an account.
tiktok.copyHint: In TikTok, tap Share, then Copy link.

faq.q: Which TikTok links work?
faq.a: Full links (tiktok.com/@user/video/…) and the short links the app creates (vm.tiktok.com and vt.tiktok.com), which we follow automatically.

faq.q: Can I download private or friends-only TikToks?
faq.a: No. Only public videos can be saved. Private videos require a TikTok login that this tool never asks for.

faq.q: Why does a TikTok link sometimes fail?
faq.a: TikTok limits automated requests, so a link can occasionally fail even though the video is public. Wait a minute and paste it again.

reddit.metaTitle: Reddit Video Downloader — Save v.redd.it Videos (MP4 + Audio)
reddit.metaDescription: Download Reddit videos for free. Paste a Reddit post or v.redd.it link and save the MP4 and, when available, the audio track separately.
reddit.lead: Paste a link to a Reddit video post or a v.redd.it link and save the video as an MP4. No account or app is needed, and if Reddit provides a separate audio track you can save that too.
reddit.copyHint: Tap Share on the post, then Copy link.

faq.q: Why does my Reddit video have no sound?
faq.a: Reddit stores a video and its audio as two separate files, and this tool can't merge them. The MP4 you download is video-only; when Reddit offers the audio track you'll see a separate Download Audio button so you can save it too.

faq.q: Do v.redd.it and share links work?
faq.a: Yes. Post links (reddit.com/r/…/comments/…), share links (…/s/…) and v.redd.it links are all accepted.

faq.q: Can I download NSFW or private-subreddit videos?
faq.a: No. Those require a logged-in Reddit account, which this tool doesn't use. Public posts work.

snapchat.metaTitle: Snapchat Spotlight Downloader — Save Spotlight Videos
snapchat.metaDescription: Free Snapchat Spotlight downloader. Paste a public Spotlight link and save the video as an MP4. No login, no app.
snapchat.lead: Paste the link of a public Snapchat Spotlight video and save it as an MP4. Short links from the Snapchat app work too, and you don't need an account.
snapchat.copyHint: Open the Spotlight video, tap Share, then Copy link.

faq.q: Which Snapchat links are supported?
faq.a: Public Spotlight links (snapchat.com/spotlight/…) and the short links the app creates (t.snapchat.com). Stories and private snaps are not supported.

faq.q: Can I download someone's Snapchat Story?
faq.a: No. Stories aren't public Spotlight videos, and they're restricted to the people they're shared with. This tool works only with public Spotlight posts.

faq.q: Can I download private snaps?
faq.a: No. Private snaps are only visible to their recipients and can't be reached through a public link.

seo.heading: The fastest way to save social media videos
paragraphs: Most social platforms don't give you a built-in way to save someone else's video to your device. Our tool solves that in one paste: drop in the link from Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, Threads, X, Pinterest, TikTok, Reddit or Snapchat, and we fetch the video file so you get a clean MP4 you can watch offline.

It works entirely in your browser — there's nothing to install, no account to create, and no personal data required. Just the public link to the video you want. That makes it safe to use on any device, whether you're on a phone between classes or at a desktop editing a compilation.

Creators use it to archive their own content before it disappears from feeds, marketers use it to build swipe files of ad creative, and everyday users use it to keep a copy of a clip a friend sent them before it gets deleted. Whatever the reason, the flow stays the same: paste, preview, download.

items.q: Is this Reels downloader really free?
items.a: Yes. There's no subscription, no watermark added, and no limit tied to an account, since no account is needed at all.

items.q: Do I need to log in to any account?
items.a: No. You only need the public link to the video. We never ask for your username or password on any platform.
No. This tool only works on public videos, since private content is intentionally restricted by each platform and isn't accessible via a shared link.

items.q: What video quality do I get?
items.a: You get the best quality available as a single MP4 file with sound — typically HD for short clips and Reels. Some long videos may be limited to a lower resolution.

items.q: Is it legal to download Reels?
items.a: Downloading for personal, offline viewing is generally fine, but re-uploading someone else's content without permission can violate copyright and Instagram's terms. Always credit the original creator.

items.q: Does this work on iPhone and Android?
items.a: Yes, it runs in any modern mobile or desktop browser without needing an app install.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How SaveReelsFast handles the limited information involved in using the site.

sections.heading: Overview
body: SaveReelsFast (savereelsfast.com) is a free tool for saving publicly available videos from popular social platforms. You do not need an account, and we never ask for your social media username or password. This policy explains what limited information is processed when you use the site.

sections.heading: Information we process
body: Links you submit: when you paste a video link, it is sent to our server, and to a backend service that runs on our behalf, so we can look up the public video. To make repeat requests fast, the result of that lookup (the link, the title and temporary download addresses) is kept in memory for up to 90 minutes and then discarded. We never store the videos themselves.
Technical data: like most websites, our hosting provider may automatically record your IP address, browser type, and the time of each request for security and reliability purposes.

sections.heading: Cookies and local storage
body: We use one functional cookie, NEXT_LOCALE, to remember the language you choose. It contains no personal information. Your browser's local and session storage also holds a few convenience settings (your recent results and whether you dismissed the install banner); that data stays on your device.
If we display advertising in the future, our advertising partners may set their own cookies. Where the law requires it, we will ask for your consent before non-essential cookies are used.

sections.heading: How we use information
body: We use the information above only to operate the service, keep it secure, prevent abuse, and understand overall performance. We do not sell your personal information.

sections.heading: Third parties
body: Videos are retrieved from the public servers of the platform they come from (for example Instagram, YouTube or TikTok). We are not affiliated with any of these platforms, and their own privacy policies apply to their services. Our site and backend are hosted by third-party providers that process technical data on our behalf.

sections.heading: Your rights
body: Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct, or delete personal data we hold about you, or to object to its processing. To make a request, contact us using the details on the Contact page.

sections.heading: Children
body: This service is not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from them.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
body: We may update this policy from time to time. The date at the top shows when it last changed.

sections.heading: Acceptance of terms
body: By using SaveReelsFast you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.

sections.heading: The service
body: SaveReelsFast helps you download publicly available videos from supported social platforms to your own device. It works only with public content and does not bypass privacy settings or logins.

sections.heading: Permitted use
body: Use the service only for content you own or have permission to save, and for personal, non-commercial purposes such as offline viewing or archiving your own work. You are responsible for how you use any downloaded content.

sections.heading: Prohibited use
body: You may not use the service to break the law, infringe copyright or other rights, re-upload other people's content without permission, harass others, or overload or attempt to disrupt the service through automated or abusive requests.

sections.heading: Intellectual property
body: All videos, captions, and images belong to their respective creators. We do not claim ownership of any content you download. Please credit the original creator whenever you share their work.

sections.heading: No affiliation
body: SaveReelsFast is an independent tool. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Instagram, Meta Platforms, Inc., YouTube, Google, X Corp., Pinterest, TikTok or any other platform. All trademarks belong to their respective owners.

sections.heading: Disclaimer of warranties
body: The service is provided "as is" and "as available" without warranties of any kind. We do not guarantee that it will be uninterrupted, error-free, or able to download every Reel, since availability depends on Instagram.

sections.heading: Limitation of liability
body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, SaveReelsFast is not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the service or of any content downloaded with it.

sections.heading: Copyright and removal requests
body: If you believe content is being handled in a way that infringes your rights, contact us with details and we will review your request promptly.

sections.heading: Changes to these terms
body: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of the service after changes means you accept the updated terms.
